SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, fiscal_period_label, period_start_date, period_end_date, weeks_in_period, fully_loaded,
       (SELECT max(sale_date) FROM fact_sales_line) AS max_sale_date,
       (SELECT max(return_date) FROM fact_return_line) AS max_return_date,
       (SELECT max(business_date) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales) AS max_rpt_date
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
WHERE period_start_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-07-01' AND DATE '2026-10-31'
ORDER BY period_start_date

WITH params AS (
    SELECT DATE '2026-08-31' AS start_date, DATE '2026-09-27' AS end_date
),
web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT 'mine_total' AS k, SUM(n.net_sales) AS v, COUNT(*) AS n FROM net_lines n, params WHERE n.business_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date
UNION ALL
SELECT 'mine_stores', SUM(n.net_sales), COUNT(*) FROM net_lines n, params WHERE n.business_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date AND n.store_id < 900
UNION ALL
SELECT 'mine_web', SUM(n.net_sales), COUNT(*) FROM net_lines n, params WHERE n.business_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date AND n.store_id = 900
UNION ALL
SELECT 'control_total', SUM(net_sales), COUNT(*) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r, params WHERE r.business_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date
UNION ALL
SELECT 'control_stores', SUM(net_sales), COUNT(*) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r, params WHERE r.business_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date AND store_id < 900
UNION ALL
SELECT 'control_web', SUM(net_sales), COUNT(*) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r, params WHERE r.business_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date AND store_id = 900
UNION ALL
SELECT 'control_999', SUM(net_sales), COUNT(*) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r, params WHERE r.business_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date AND store_id = 999

SELECT 'sales_dup_id' AS k, COUNT(*) AS n, COALESCE(SUM(extra),0) AS extra_rows FROM (SELECT sales_line_id, COUNT(*)-1 AS extra FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date >= DATE '2026-08-24' GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'sales_dup_receipt_line', COUNT(*), COALESCE(SUM(extra),0) FROM (SELECT receipt_id, line_no, COUNT(*)-1 AS extra FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date >= DATE '2026-08-24' GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'return_dup_id', COUNT(*), COALESCE(SUM(extra),0) FROM (SELECT return_line_id, COUNT(*)-1 AS extra FROM fact_return_line WHERE return_date >= DATE '2026-08-24' GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'web_dup_order', COUNT(*), COALESCE(SUM(extra),0) FROM (SELECT web_order_id, COUNT(*)-1 AS extra FROM fact_web_order GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'web_lines_no_order_row', COUNT(*), 0 FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.store_key IN (SELECT store_key FROM dim_store WHERE store_id=900) AND f.sale_date >= DATE '2026-08-01' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_web_order w WHERE w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'sales_lines_in_999_or_test_in_P05', COUNT(*), 0 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND (s.store_id=999 OR p.category='ZZ Test')
UNION ALL
SELECT 'web_status_' || status, COUNT(*), 0 FROM fact_web_order WHERE order_ts_utc >= TIMESTAMP '2026-08-25' GROUP BY status

WITH x AS (
  SELECT 'excluded_999_or_test_sales_P05' AS k, SUM(f.net_amount) AS v, COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND (s.store_id=999 OR p.category='ZZ Test')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'processing_orders_net_ordered_by_P05_end', SUM(f.net_amount), COUNT(DISTINCT w.web_order_id)
  FROM fact_web_order w JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.receipt_id=w.web_order_id
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE w.status='processing' AND CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', w.order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) <= DATE '2026-09-27' AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'processing_orders_total', SUM(f.net_amount), COUNT(DISTINCT w.web_order_id)
  FROM fact_web_order w JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.receipt_id=w.web_order_id
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE w.status='processing' AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'orders_with_dispatch_null_delivered_collected', NULL, COUNT(*) FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected') AND dispatch_ts_utc IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'orders_dispatch_before_order', NULL, COUNT(*) FROM fact_web_order WHERE dispatch_ts_utc < order_ts_utc
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'sales_lines_null_net_or_neg', SUM(net_amount), COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND (net_amount IS NULL OR net_amount < 0)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'rpt_vs_days_missing', NULL, 28 - COUNT(DISTINCT business_date) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
)
SELECT * FROM x

SELECT w.status, COUNT(DISTINCT w.web_order_id) AS orders, COUNT(f.sales_line_id) AS lines, SUM(f.net_amount) AS net,
       MIN(f.sale_date) AS min_sale, MAX(f.sale_date) AS max_sale
FROM fact_web_order w LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.receipt_id = w.web_order_id
WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', w.order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-01' AND DATE '2026-10-05'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
